items.description: Landlord must give Tenant its PM Schedule as far in advance as is reasonably practicable.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide Tenant with Landlord’s PM Schedule as far in advance as is reasonably practicable.

items.anchor_event: any change in the PM Schedule
items.description: Landlord must perform PM Activities, substantially follow the PM Schedule, and give written notice before changing the schedule except in an emergency.
items.span_text: Landlord agrees to perform the PM Activities, to substantially adhere to the then current PM Schedule in connection with such performance, and, except in an emergency, to give Tenant at least seven (7) calendar days’ written notice prior to any change in the PM Schedule.

items.anchor_event: the date upon which Tenant desires to perform its PM Audit
items.description: Tenant must deliver a PM Audit Notice to Landlord at least thirty days before the desired audit date.
items.span_text: Tenant shall exercise the foregoing right by delivering its PM Audit Notice to Landlord no less than thirty (30) days before the date upon which Tenant desires to perform its PM Audit.

items.anchor_event: Landlord’s receipt of Tenant’s PM Audit Notice
items.description: Landlord must respond to the PM Audit Notice within five business days with the audit date, time and location.
items.span_text: Landlord shall respond to Tenant’s PM Audit Notice within five (5) business days after Landlord’s receipt of Tenant’s PM Audit Notice with the date, time and location of Tenant’s PM Audit.

items.description: If an audit shows Landlord is delinquent under the PM Schedule, Tenant must give written notice and Landlord must cure within the time allowed by the Lease.
items.span_text: If Tenant’s PM Audit reveals that Landlord is delinquent in complying with the PM Schedule, Tenant shall deliver written notice to Landlord of such delinquency, and Landlord shall cure such delinquency within the time allowed pursuant to Section 16.1.1 of this Lease.
items.trigger: If Tenant’s PM Audit reveals that Landlord is delinquent in complying with the PM Schedule

items.anchor_event: next scheduled occurrence of the PM Activity to which the PM Change Request applies
items.description: Tenant must submit a PM Change Request at least twenty calendar days before the next scheduled occurrence of the affected PM Activity.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to provide Landlord a PM Change Request no fewer than twenty (20) calendar days prior to the next scheduled occurrence of the PM Activity to which the PM Change Request applies.
items.trigger: in the event that Tenant desires that Landlord make a PM Change

items.anchor_event: Landlord’s receipt of the PM Change Request
items.description: Landlord must provide a PM Change Cost Estimate within three business days after receiving the request, if it can accommodate the change.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide Tenant PM Change Cost Estimate, within three (3) business days after Landlord’s receipt of the PM Change Request.
items.trigger: In the event that Landlord is reasonably able to accommodate the PM Change

items.anchor_event: Tenant’s receipt of the PM Change Cost Estimate
items.description: Tenant must tell Landlord within five business days of receiving the cost estimate whether it elects to implement the PM Change.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to notify Landlord within five (5) business days after Tenant’s receipt of the PM Change Cost Estimate as to whether or not Tenant elects to have the PM Change implemented.

items.anchor_event: Tenant’s receipt of an invoice for same from Landlord
items.description: Tenant must pay Landlord's actual incremental costs of the PM Change within thirty calendar days after receiving an invoice.
items.span_text: If Tenant timely elects to have the PM Change implemented, Tenant shall pay Landlord the actual incremental amount of the costs incurred by Landlord in connection with the PM Change within thirty (30) calendar days after Tenant’s receipt of an invoice for same from Landlord.
items.trigger: If Tenant timely elects to have the PM Change implemented
